stagingLines: [d77] 📯 Ashford calls on the obligation: Counsel. "Ashford wants Haven's read on the season." Honor it, or refuse — both are remembered.
[d77] ◈ SYSTEM: "You are not the head of this. That is the point. A realm of 6 fires — and Ashford wants Haven's oath. The audience LOVES a binding."

[d77] 📯 Ashford's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
[d77] 📓 Codex: National beat staged: belong (6 villages).
[d77] Malik stared at their hands for a long time today. Something is changing.
[d77] Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
[d77] Ants march past your boot, laden. You follow them to a seep. +1L water (risky). (ant_trail)
[d77] ⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
[d77] Village meal: +2120 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
[d77] 🩹 Lena makes rounds — Darius gets bound up properly. (15 → 30 HP)
[d77] Vasyl and Farid are comparing scars like trading cards.
[d77] ◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Ellis — 3 days worked on the land. It offers Game Sense. Earned, not given. (game_sense: villager System grant)
[d77] Ellis came back with 598 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
[d77] Malik and Lena lingered over the fire together.
[d77] Lena sits with Ellis — cool cloth, bitter tea, watching the breathing.
[d77] The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.

[d79] "Three losses. The crowd is getting that look. You know the look."
